text:
Amanda R: Hey folks — heads up: after I ran the bulk reviewer import just now a subset of folks report the review form is locked for edits. Getting this error when they open the form:

```
Error: This form is currently being processed by the system. Try again later. (code: FORM_LOCKED)
```

Amanda R: I only imported ~120 reviewer assignments, not a huge batch. We haven't touched the handback window setting. Anyone seen this before? :eyes:

Ben S: ugh. not ideal. can you drop one sample user email? i'll check import logs and the forms service status.

Amanda R: sent in DM — jen@redwood.ai. She says she submitted her review earlier today but now can't reopen to edit. screenshot attached.

People Ops Bot: Incident created: INC-2458 — "Form lockout after bulk import". Assigned to people-ops oncall.

Liam K: quick triage: 1) check whether the import created duplicate form instances in the DB (we've seen a race where two imports touched the same form row and triggered a processing lock) 2) check google/forms export queue length 3) if it's widespread, create a temporary override that flips the form to read/write for affected users only.

Ben S: logs show the import job retried a failed webhook, we have a 409 from forms-service around 1768431899 which maps to a lock. looks like 47 users hit the lock path.

Jess M: for immediate mitigation, could we: 1) generate a temporary clone of the affected form and share that link with the affected reviewers, 2) ask managers to pause handback enforcement for 24h, and 3) push a rollback of the last import job if we see bad diffs? Thoughts? :+1:

Amanda R: cloning works for small teams but will be messy for people tracking responses. If we do the clone approach we should send a clear note to managers and CS about which people were moved. I'll prepare the manager text.

Ben S: agreed. i'll queue a rollback if we confirm the import payload differs from what was in the staging preview. also adding a temporary toggle in the ops console to clear FORM_LOCKED flags for the affected form IDs (non-invasive).

People Ops Bot: INC-2458 update: rollback queued (PR #3421), ops-toggle created, affected users list exported to /internal/people-ops/incidents/INC-2458/affected.csv

Liam K: once rollback is complete i'll run a sanity pass to reindex form rows and then remove the lock flags. ETA 35–40m.

Jess M: copy. i'll draft comms for managers + people with step-by-step: what happened, temporary clone link (if used), expected timeline for re-enable, how to escalate if someone lost submissions.

Amanda R: thanks team. please ping me in #incidents when it's cleared so i can notify folks and close the manual callbacks. :pray:

Ben S: ping when rollback merged. keeping this thread here for the comms copy + quick notes so ops can follow.

People Ops Bot: INC-2458 status: rollback merged at 1768432850, reindex job started.

Liam K: reindex finished, lock flags cleared at 1768432910. I've spot-checked Jen and two others; forms reopenable and edits persist.

Amanda R: verified with Jen over DM — all good. Closing loop with managers now. Thanks all! :tada:
